description: Baseline module configuration applied before every spec file. Approval (maker-checker) flags are set explicitly to the upstream defaults (on), and the fe-core menu is the one of the release server, so a UAT run does not depend on what was left in the database. A spec that needs another value overrides it in its own before() hook; the next spec file starts again from this baseline. 'configFile' is relative to this file; entries with "absent": true are deleted so the module falls back to its code defaults.
